# Recover a partially completed entry after accidental dismissal

## What & Why
Escape now dismisses answer and opportunity dialogs as expected, but any partially completed draft is discarded. Letting users recover a recently dismissed draft would reduce accidental data loss while preserving the fast keyboard dismissal flow.

## Done looks like
- A recently dismissed answer or opportunity draft can be recovered from a clear, non-blocking prompt.
- Recovery is available after Escape and other cancellation paths without overwriting an existing saved entry.
- Recovered values reopen in the correct form and can be edited or saved normally.
